lead.claim: Integrate Traditional Chinese Exercises for better physical function and mental health.
lead.context: An umbrella review examined if these exercises improve outcomes for various musculoskeletal disorders.

supporting.claim: Emphasize sleep extension to improve athletic performance and recovery.
supporting.context: A systematic review explored how sleep duration affects athletic performance, cognitive function, and recovery.

supporting.claim: Visual feedback balance training may improve balance and reduce fear of falling in stroke.
supporting.context: A randomized controlled trial compared robot-assisted gait training with visual feedback balance training for stroke patients.

supporting.claim: Modified razor curls are a practical alternative to Nordic hamstring exercises for football players.
supporting.context: A randomized controlled trial compared the effects of two exercises on hamstring strength and posterior-chain endurance.

supporting.claim: Does craniosacral therapy improve postural control or autonomic function in MS patients?
supporting.context: A randomized controlled trial investigated if adding craniosacral therapy to conventional physiotherapy affected postural responses and autonomic function in multiple sclerosis.
